| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | How the size of the one-month revision moves with the number of collection days before first release | A | 1 | Release calendar and monthly vintages: about 1–2 days to assemble, from public release dates and archived releases. Fit time: measured by Stage 1 |
| O3 | How much of the one- and two-month revisions comes from late sample reports, and how much from seasonal-factor revision | A | 2 | Needs NSA and SA vintages side by side. Fit time: unknown until Stage 1 measures a first fit |

| O6 | How revision size moves with CES sample size and sample attrition | B | 1 | Sample-size and attrition series: several days to hand-build from archived releases and budget justifications. Fit time: measured by Stage 2 |
| O4 | How revision size moves with real BLS appropriations, continuing resolutions and shutdowns | B | 2 | Appropriations, CR and shutdown series: several days to hand-build from budget justifications |

Tracks: A — collection interval and revision size (research). B — budget, staffing and attrition (research). B is split from A because A rests on sharp month-to-month calendar variation that public release dates give directly. B's covariates move slowly, trend together and must be hand-built, and B's answer does not change A's model. Track order: A, then B.
